propositions: Four code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must be flipped from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50 respectively) based on code-v3 corpus validation (1760 sidecars, 1173 changes, 4359 findings) with validity >= 0.83 for all would-block findings.

The approved blocking set must expand from 3 members (secret-detection, high-critical-security, security) to exactly 7 members, enforced by updating three governance-pin tests to prevent unapproved criterion additions.

Regression and error-handling must be added as new base-reviewer dimension entries in criteria_routing.json with inert exec/applies_to fields, only consulted for default_posture/block_threshold/blocking_enabled.
Three governance tests must be updated to pin the new 7-member blocking set: test_impact_model_versioning.py, test_code_review_ws2.py, test_code_review_deletion_impact.py.
The calibration landing must precede or coordinate with RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) CriteriaSnapshot capture to preserve the calibrated thresholds in the immutable baseline.
The change is purely in-process threshold configuration with no CI provider or external trigger involvement, ensuring full portability across environments.
